reviewer: Codex; same author in a separate review pass
method: Manual comparison with unchanged roadmap exit text, real UI observations and private test evidence; current native report graph and regression tests; six negative evidence-validation mutations. Metadata checker does not authenticate the provider. Final registered acceptance-only check validates already captured genuine live findings; it is static and makes no new UI call. Natural expiration is never certified. Final fresh sign-out observation and rejection were rechecked; both final native OS reports were downloaded and verified.
impact_assessment: Only dispatch preflight/CLI contract changed: current_context is mandatory and has no cached fallback. SQLite schema, frozen request and observation classification remain unchanged; historical positive evidence is explicitly old source and is corroborated by current regression tests, not relabeled as a new send. Exact current source passed 272 tests on actual Windows and Linux. No unknown attempt was resent or confirmed and no new provider message was sent. Prior accepted P00-P02 receipts are unchanged. Before any P04 implementation, accepted estimate omission was discovered; P03 reopened for metadata-only correction. Guard source, both current native OS results and original URs/phase order unchanged.

findings.description: Prepared ticket used only historical authentication context. Mandatory current observed context now rejects sign-out/expiry/unknown or identity mismatch before ticket/ledger mutation; six new tests and real signed-out context checked.
Unbounded wait for natural expiry was an assistant-added condition. ADR-009 makes the original feasibility scope explicit without changing roadmap, protected requirements or phase order.

Natural expiration timing, real partial response recovery, quota and cross-account behavior are not certified. These remain mandatory product verification work in P09-P11, with planning contingency; no feasibility claim promotes them to PASS.

First formal run was blocked before check execution because LIVE_BROWSER evidence mode was unregistered. Registration now explicitly associates this acceptance-only static validation with actual live evidence; mandatory separate review and original governance requirement retained. Final source revalidated on both OSs.

Initial remaining estimate omitted four additional Browser and three additional API adapters already required by SCOPE. Corrected formula: baseline 270-442 + scoped extras 66-132 = 336-574 active hours; 25% reserve yields 420-718. Earlier frozen acceptance retained and superseded before starting P04.

criteria.criterion: یک مسیر مرورگر واقعی با ورود کاربر، ارسال، دریافت پاسخ و ادامهٔ گفتگو شاهد دارد.
criteria.notes: Actual manual user login, three ledger-backed sends, two confirmed complete responses and same-conversation continuation are preserved in historical private evidence and sanitized public findings. Account/model scope is visible UI continuity only; full server identity certification is not claimed.

criteria.criterion: حالت ورود منقضی و مشاهدهٔ نامطمئن روشن است؛ راه‌حل مانع احتمالی پیش از ادامه تعیین شده است.
criteria.notes: Expired/invalid/unknown authentication handling is explicit: true controlled logout was observed after a prepared intent; both start interfaces reject its fresh SIGNED_OUT context without dispatch. EXPIRED is separately synthetic contract coverage; natural/server-timed expiry remains UNKNOWN. Real observer loss preserved UNKNOWN_DELIVERY with no automatic resend. Barriers are addressed by stop-before-dispatch, secure/manual reauthentication and exact fresh binding verification; unclear post-send state requires read-only verification, not resend. Original roadmap does not require waiting indefinitely for natural expiry. This PASS is for limited feasibility and an established barrier solution, not real natural-expiration certification.

criteria.criterion: برآورد و جدول قابلیت‌های اتصال به‌روز شده‌اند.
criteria.notes: Final capability table and transparent arithmetic reflect all five providers in both modes: remaining base 270-442 plus 66-132 additional connection hours = 336-574; existing 25% risk reserve yields 420-718 active hours. External waits unknown; no budget or capability guarantee, browser remains mandatory. Corrected before P04 implementation; roadmap and user scope unchanged.
